name: Relative Peeling Obstructions at Cube Boundaries of Every Dimension
statement: Let $0\in C\subseteq A,B$ satisfy the hypotheses of the rooted-failure edge transfer: $C$ is dismantlable ample, the two ample wings peel both to $C$ and to $0$, and $A\cap B=C$ with matching shadow intersection. For a fresh $k$-set $E$, put $R_A=Q_E\setminus\{1^E\}$, $R_B=Q_E\setminus\{0^E\}$, $D_k=\{0\}\times Q_E$, and $Y_k=(C\times Q_E)\cup((A\setminus C)\times R_A)\cup((B\setminus C)\times R_B)$. Then $Y_k$ is ample and dismantlable ample. It peels to every nonempty proper face of $D_k$ and to each punctured boundary cube $\{0\}\times R_A,\{0\}\times R_B$; for $k=2$ it peels to every nonempty proper ample subfamily of $D_2$, including all four punctured squares. It peels to $D_k$ exactly when $C$ peels to $0$. If $(C,0)$ is a rooted factor using every old coordinate, every proper pc-minor of the marked pair $(Y_k,D_k)$ with nonempty target peels to its target, although the original pair does not. Certified inputs of orders $289,291,290$ yield $|Y_k|=292\cdot2^k-3$ and isometric dimension $12+k$ for every $k\ge1$.
proof: Supports using a proper subset of the new coordinates are shattered exactly according to $A\cup B$, while supports using all of $E$ are shattered exactly according to $C$. The resulting shadow count equals $(2^k-1)|A\cup B|+|C|=|Y_k|$, proving ampleness. Relative wing orders clear the two punctured-cube rows to $C\times Q_E$, so the family is peelable. A peeling retaining the whole boundary cube would record first losses of complete $E$-fibers and project to a peeling of $C$ ending at $0$; conversely such a rooted peeling lifts. Every proper face avoids one puncture, allowing one wing and then the core to be cleared to that face. To retain $R_A$, clear the opposite wing, delete the missing row copy of each core vertex in a core peeling, and finish in $A\times R_A$; symmetry gives $R_B$. When $k=2$, the two remaining punctures are handled by clearing both repairs in the punctured middle row, deleting its core, and peeling the resulting three-row path from its outer rows inward. Root-preserving old-coordinate minors make the core peel to its root, new-coordinate restrictions invoke proper-face retention, and new-coordinate contractions produce $(A\cup B)\times Q_{E\setminus\{e\}}$; these observations prove relative pc-minimality. The size formula follows by substitution.
